title: PG-09.1 Identity, admission and ACFA boundary (memev)
request: Programme contract for work package WP09 in memev: Identity, admission and ACFA boundary. Proposed and unsigned; the signer signs it after the red-team gate. Source: the programme decomposition of 31 Oct 2026 (docs/scope-one/programme/WBS.md, docs/scope-one/programme/DECOMPOSITION.md, docs/scope-one/programme/fragments/WP09.json) and the owner notes behind docs/scope-one/programme/REQUIREMENTS.md. Depends on tasks outside this contract: WP04-02, WP06-02. Covers only what the Scope One contracts (SO-1.01 to SO-1.11) do not already cover; the mapping is in contracts/programme/manifest.json. Boundary with SO-2.12: WP09-02 (the contribution-admission boundary) is a prerequisite of federated computation and is not repeated there. Signed vault contract MEM-145, MEM-146 and MEM-147 (cited by id only): foundation: human binding of agent roles; WP09-01 reuses it. Signed vault contract WO-05-D (cited by id only): the external trust service specification; the adapters of WP09-02 and WP09-03 sit on its boundary and this spec does not specify the service. Pending owner decision (which layer to build against): the unsigned Scope One fold SO-F-01 to SO-F-13 (cited by id only) overlaps this spec at SO-F-01, SO-F-08. Which layer is built against is open and is the owner's call. This spec is not signed until it is decided, and nothing is dropped on the strength of the unsigned fold. Owner decisions of 31 Oct 2026 apply: crdt-merge stays in its own repository and is reached only across the WO-05-A call-out boundary (never vendored, no memev-merge); tiers are free core, Personal at $12/month or $120/year for up to 3 computers, and contact us above that; there is no Federated tier.
